title: Pick a pack for the day
observation:
Daypack — 12 L, 420 g. Open product: A.
Trail pack — 24 L, 780 g. Open product: B.
goals: Open the product page for the lighter bag.
Open the product page for the bag with greater capacity.

texts.phrasing1: Open the Daypack product. Its capacity is 12 litres and its weight is 420 grams.
texts.phrasing2: The Daypack weighs 420 grams and holds 12 litres. This action opens its product page.

texts.phrasing1: Open the Trail pack product. Its capacity is 24 litres and its weight is 780 grams.
texts.phrasing2: The Trail pack weighs 780 grams and holds 24 litres. This action opens its product page.

answer_reasons: 420 g is lighter than 780 g, so the Daypack fits the first goal.
24 L is greater than 12 L, so the Trail pack fits the second goal.

title: Reserve a study room
observation:
Cedar room — capacity 4; available 14:00–16:00; step-free. Reserve: A.
Maple room — capacity 8; available 15:00–17:00; step-free. Reserve: B.
goals: Reserve a step-free room for three people from 14:00 to 15:00.
Reserve a step-free room for six people from 15:00 to 16:00.

texts.phrasing1: Select the Cedar room. It seats four, has step-free access, and is available between 14:00 and 16:00.
texts.phrasing2: Cedar is available from 14:00 to 16:00, accommodates four people, and has step-free access. The action selects this room.

texts.phrasing1: Select the Maple room. It seats eight, has step-free access, and is available between 15:00 and 17:00.
texts.phrasing2: Maple is available from 15:00 to 17:00, accommodates eight people, and has step-free access. The action selects this room.

answer_reasons: Cedar accommodates three people and is available for the full requested hour. Maple is not available at 14:00.
Maple accommodates six people and is available for the requested hour. Cedar only seats four.

title: Choose an admission pass
observation:
Day pass — $18; 09:00–17:00; weekdays only. Select: A.
Any-day pass — $25; 09:00–17:00; weekdays and weekends. Select: B.
goals: Select the cheapest pass that permits entry at 10:00 on a Saturday.
Select the cheapest pass that permits entry at 10:00 on a Tuesday.

texts.phrasing1: Select the Day pass. It costs $18 and permits entry from 09:00 to 17:00 on weekdays.
texts.phrasing2: For $18, the Day pass provides weekday entry between 09:00 and 17:00. This action selects that pass.

texts.phrasing1: Select the Any-day pass. It costs $25 and permits entry from 09:00 to 17:00 on weekdays and weekends.
texts.phrasing2: For $25, the Any-day pass provides entry between 09:00 and 17:00 on weekdays and weekends. This action selects that pass.

answer_reasons: Saturday is a weekend day, so only the Any-day pass permits the requested visit.
Both passes permit Tuesday entry, and the $18 Day pass costs less.
